description: Retrieval-verification dataset for the trench namespace (Trench Express, the bonding-curve launchpad on Robinhood Chain 4663). Every live tool carries at least one blind row, written the way a model would phrase the user's outcome without naming the launchpad, and at least one protocol-aware row that names Trench. Queries were authored from the manifests and the navigation entry only, never from the retrieval index text, so a hit measures the index rather than a copy of itself.

queries.query: what tokens just launched on the Robinhood Chain bonding curve today
screen bonding curve coins that are more than 80 percent of the way to graduating into a pool
browse Trench Express launchpad tokens sorted by recent activity, curve stage only
find a launchpad coin whose ticker is DOGWIF on Robinhood Chain
look up a Trench token by name to get its contract address
is anyone actually buying this curve token, show me the recent fills for 0x58659Ef9Be57216632BFD341FC57736a429EFB91
recent trade tape for a Trench token, buys and sells with makers and timestamps
how many tokens do I get for 0.05 ETH on this bonding curve, including fees and price impact
price selling 2,500,000 units of a curve token back to ETH before I commit
get a Trench curve quote for spending 0.01 ETH with 1% slippage
buy 0.02 ETH worth of this Robinhood Chain curve token now
dump my whole bag of this curve coin back into ETH and broadcast it
execute the Trench buy I just quoted and sign it with my wallet
what would it cost me to create a new memecoin on Robinhood Chain, fee plus gas, without deploying anything
dry run creating a token with a 0.0005 ETH prebuy so I can see the total before signing
simulate a Trench Express launch and tell me the predicted token address and creation fee
which pictures has the user already staged in the app that I can attach to a new coin
check the Trench photo locker before planning a launch and pick an image id
let the user deploy the coin themselves, open a prefilled creation form and wait for their decision
I am in a restricted session, ask the human to approve the Trench token creation in the app form instead of signing it myself
deploy the new coin on the Robinhood Chain curve for real, name PIXEL ticker PXL, and prebuy 0.001 ETH
go ahead and launch the token on Trench Express, sign and broadcast the creation transaction
list the coins I created from this wallet and how the initial buy on each went
show my own Trench launches with their creation transactions, most recent first
